headline: Record Permian volumes; tax gain flatters profit
summary_short: Adjusted EBITDA rose 6% to $2,238M and diluted EPS rose to $2.13 from $1.49, helped by a one-time $336M noncash tax benefit. ONEOK raised 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $8.5B-$8.6B.
summary_long: NGL raw feed throughput rose 6% and refined products volumes shipped rose 6%, with record Permian volumes. Refined Products and Crude Adjusted EBITDA rose to $685M from $582M and Natural Gas Pipelines to $231M from $200M, while NGL slipped to $718M from $748M. The tax benefit added $0.53 per share. ONEOK extinguished nearly $5.5B of debt, completed a $9B minority equity investment and the Brazos Midland acquisition, and got upgraded to BBB+. Dividend declared: $1.07 per share.
confidence_notes: EPS and net income include a one-time $336M ($0.53 per share) noncash income tax benefit from the reorganization tied to the minority equity transaction. Adjusted EBITDA is non-GAAP and includes a $53 million net benefit from minority equity and Brazos transactions. Deltas computed from release figures.

drivers.explanation: Includes a one-time noncash income tax benefit of $336 million, or $0.53 per diluted share, from the ONEOK reorganization tied to the minority equity transaction.
Higher NGL, refined products and natural gas volumes and higher optimization and marketing activity; Refined Products and Crude and Natural Gas Pipelines segments gained.
Includes a 16% increase in the Gulf Coast/Permian region.
CEO cites higher Permian Basin volumes and integration of systems, and says momentum supports another guidance raise.
